properties.NAME: COUNTY I (ext)
properties.CHANGE: COUNTY I (Okla. Terr., extinct) created from non-county area in Oklahoma Territory (Wichita Indian Reservation) by proclamation of the U.S. Asst. Secretary of the Interior. COUNTY I was never fully organized.
properties.CITATION: ("Will Open," Weekly Oklahoma State Capital [newspaper], 25 July 1891; Morris, 119-120; Morris, Goins, and McReynolds, map 54)
